messages:
Priya (Design): Quick check 1: proposal to add a compact 'compare + action' micropanel when you click two timeline versions. Not full modal, anchored overlay with actions (rollback, route percent). Keep it low-friction but safe.

Noah (PM): Love it. Main constraint: any destructive action must follow safety rules: small changes inline, large changes require explicit confirmation with reason. Also surface recent SLO breaches.

Ivy (Frontend): Implementation notes: overlay anchored to row, keyboard open with Space/Enter, close with Esc. Lazy-load sparklines. For single-click rollbacks we should still show a transient confirmation toast with undo. For larger deltas open alertdialog.

Jared (A11y): Accessibility checklist: overlay should be role="region" aria-label="Version comparison"; announce a short summary via aria-live polite when it opens. If the user opens via keyboard, focus the first actionable control. For confirm modal use role="alertdialog", trap focus, and provide aria-describedby for the reason field.

Priya (Design): Copy sketches: header: "Compare v7 1 v9"; summary: "Latency +6%  Errors -1%  Config: feature-x toggled"; actions: [Rollback to v7] [Route 10% to v9] [Open full metrics].

Noah (PM): Product rule: single-click allowed only if delta <=15% AND no SLO breach. If target=100% or delta>15% or SLO breach -> alertdialog with required short reason and checkbox 'I understand'. Log user id + reason.

Ivy (Frontend): Percent picker inline: keyboard accessible, arrow keys for stepper, validate >0 and <=100. If user enters >15% show inline warning and darken primary to trigger modal flow. We'll add analytics events for confirm vs modal.

Jared (A11y): Screen-reader messages: when overlay opens announce: "Comparing versions 7 and 9: latency up six percent, errors down one percent." When action completes: "Rollback completed: v7 is now live. Undo available for 2 minutes." Keep messages <= 120 chars and use aria-live="assertive" for final state.

Priya (Design): Micro-interaction: overlay fades+slides 120ms. Timeline lane briefly highlights with a 1s subtle fade to draw attention. Respect prefers-reduced-motion: no slide, just appear. Small visual badge if SLO breach present: red dot and text 'SLO breach' which disables single-click.

Ivy (Frontend): CSS sketch for reduced-motion:
```
.overlay { transform: translateY(8px); opacity: 0; transition: transform .12s ease, opacity .12s ease; }
.overlay.show { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .overlay { transition: none; transform: none; }}
```

Noah (PM): Ops asked to require explicit reason if rollback affects >10% traffic or reverts production, and to include a 'notify team' checkbox. We'll add to product doc.

audit-bot: Audit log: compare opened v7/v9 by priya (uid: u_877); events: overlay_open, compare_viewed.

Jared (A11y): One more: ensure buttons include target in accessible name (e.g., "Rollback to version 7") so SR users understand the action. Also ensure focus returns to a logical element after overlay closes.

Priya (Design): I'll put mocks and copy variants into Figma and tag frontend/a11y. @Ivy please add final thresholds and logging details to the product doc. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
